cards.meaning: bribe; to bribe — money or goods given to buy an official favor
cards.example: Ang pagdakip sa dating Speaker ay resulta ng imbestigasyon sa suhol na natanggap niya mula sa mga proyekto ng gobyerno.
cards.exampleMeaning: The arrest of the former Speaker is the result of an investigation into the bribes he received from government projects.
cards.note: Legal/news register — distinct from the more casual street word 'lagay.' 'Suhol' is the exact term used once a formal case exists.

cards.meaning: arrest; the act of apprehending someone, especially under a court order
cards.example: Ang pagdakip sa dating Speaker ay resulta ng imbestigasyon sa suhol na natanggap niya mula sa mga proyekto ng gobyerno.
cards.exampleMeaning: The arrest of the former Speaker is the result of an investigation into the bribes he received from government projects.
cards.note: Carries more weight than the borrowed 'pag-aresto' — typically reserved for high-profile or long-investigated cases, with a sense of 'finally caught.'

cards.meaning: besides this; in addition to this — formal connective for adding a related but distinct point
cards.example: 出口保持强劲增长。除此之外，进口增速却不及预期。
cards.examplePinyin: Chūkǒu bǎochí qiángjìng zēngzhǎng. Chú cǐ zhī wài, jìnkǒu zēngsù què bùjí yùqī.
cards.exampleMeaning: Exports have maintained strong growth. Besides that, import growth has fallen short of expectations, though.
cards.note: 书面语/formal register — casual speech favors 另外 or 还有; 除此之外 signals a structured, finance-desk-style argument.

cards.meaning: weak domestic demand — a fixed economic collocation, not built freely from its parts
cards.example: 除此之外，内需疲软的问题依然没有得到解决。
cards.examplePinyin: Chú cǐ zhī wài, nèi xū pí ruǎn de wèntí yīrán méiyǒu dédào jiějué.
cards.exampleMeaning: Besides that, the problem of weak domestic demand still hasn't been resolved.
cards.note: Broader than 消费低迷 (weak consumption alone) — covers consumption, investment, and government spending together; reach for it when weakness is structural, not just a bad retail quarter.
